theorems.name: Submission.dorag_ted_pl_geometric_limit
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] (v : ℕ → X) (a q : ℝ), 0 ≤ q → q ≤ 1 / 4 → (∀ j : ℕ, dist (v j) (v (j + 1)) ^ 2 ≤ a * q ^ j) → ∃ w : X, Tendsto v atTop (𝓝 w) ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, dist (v j) w ^ 2 ≤ 4 * a * q ^ j
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
